item.tib: rje sman ri ba'i mkhan rabs nyer lnga ba skyabs rje 'gro mgon rin po che'i rnam thar ge sar 'bum bzhad
item.coloph: zhes snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa rje mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi brgyud 'dzin mkhan rabs nyer lnga pa skyabs rje 'gro ba'i mgon po shes rab g.yung drung dbang gi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar ge sar 'bum bzhad ces bya ba 'di ni/ sku nyid kyi zhabs drung du nye bar 'khod pa/ gsol ming shel 'od dang / bstan rgyal dang*/ sde gnyer g.yung drung dbang phyug ye bstan bcas nas nye bar bskul ba la bsten/ skyabs mchog gi bka' lung bdud rtsi theg pa spyi bor 'bebs (babs) pa dang*/ gzhan yang bu slob tshad ldan 'ga' yi ngag las thos pa rnams 'khyug ('chug) med du phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te/ rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs shing / gang gi slobs (slob) 'bangs su gtogs pa thos chung bstan 'dzin du 'bod pa'i bdag gis/ sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta lor hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig mig dmar dbyug pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po'i nyin/ dpal ldan mkhar sna'i dgon du sbyar ba'i dge legs des bdag gzhan thams cad skyabs rje mchog gi zhabs drung du skyes te sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur cig/
